description: Multi-scale deformable attention (Deformable-DETR MSDeformAttn). Forward: for each (batch, query, head), bilinearly sample the multi-scale value feature at num_points sampling locations per level (coordinates from sampling_locations normalized to [0,1]), then compute the attention-weighted sum over all levels and points to produce the output column. Backward: compute gradients w.r.t. value (scatter-add bilinear weights ring the sampling point), sampling_locations, and attention_weights.
formula: output[b,q,m*D+c] = sum_l sum_p attention_weights[b,q,m,l*P+p] * bilinear(value[b, spatial_shapes[l], :, :], sampling_locations[b,q,m,l,p,0], sampling_locations[b,q,m,l,p,1], m, c), where h_im=loc_h*H_l-0.5, w_im=loc_w*W_l-0.5 (align_corners=False, padding zero); D=C/HD

shape_meanings.PT: number of sampling points per head per level

io_tensors.name: value
io_tensors.desc: Multi-scale value features (masked), C_D = C//HD channels per head

io_tensors.name: value_level_start_index
io_tensors.desc: Start index of each level in flattened spatial dimension
